IMPLEMENTATION ROADMAP — v0.1
R0 reference (this package): schemas + registry + local project runtime + novice web UI.
R1 foundation: durable SQLite HEIMDALL store, file ingestion/indexing, job/event/checkpoint engine, provider abstraction, tests.
R2 desktop: signed macOS SwiftUI shell, Finder integration, Keychain, local service lifecycle.
R3 specialist adapters: migrate canonical assistant packages and regression suites.
R4 edenOS: edenUI/edenAPI/EDEN Connect adapters, permissions, multi-user.
R5 server/web: authenticated LAN/remote access, headless automation, API tokens, observability.
R6 hardening: migrations, backups, fault injection, privacy controls, packaging/notarization, long-run tests.
